bio.text: Carl Lambrecht is the Republican candidate for Illinois' 10th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Brad Schneider.
His career experience includes working as an optics manufacturer.
He is a Highland Park business owner and Moraine Township precinct committeeperson who ran for the Illinois House's 58th District in 2024.
